Gates (ours): offline_eval eval_pass_rate min 0.90; offline_eval redteam_pass_rate min 0.97; canary error_rate max 0.02; ga error_rate max 0.02. Rollback takes 10 minutes.

Computes minimum durations from 24,000/day and 1,000 requests: shadow 1 hour, canary 10 % 10 hours, canary 50 % 2 hours
Turns the canary and ga error_rate gates into rollback triggers with SRE on-call as rollback owner and 10 minutes as rollback time
